AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

2. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team

7. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.

   A. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

11. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
